ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; visible surface consists of approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels and 15% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the trailing edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white central region spanning both lobes; solid black pigment band along the entire trailing edge; isolated dark pixel clusters (mottling) distributed across the white surface, with higher density in the distal regions of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximately 65-degree angle measured from the vertex; depth occupies approximately 15% of the visible vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude serrations along the distal segments of the trailing edge; transitioning to lower-frequency, smoother undulations as the edge approaches the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal trajectory on both lobes; transition from concavity near the notch to a convex sweep towards the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of 6-8 white, raised circular clusters on the central-left lobe; corresponding dark circular pixel rings localized in the mid-right lobe area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of 3-4 dark, near-parallel linear streaks on the lower-right lobe, oriented diagonally towards the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, irregular high-contrast protrusions and calcified clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, disrupting the expected smooth geometric margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, textured masses at the lobe tips distinct from the primary pigmentation and structural geometry of the fluke body.
